theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_tc_rs_radius_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (Rp : IMRep U (m + 1)) (R t : ℝ), closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ U → Rp.Represents S → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball 0 R → S.boundary ω = 0) → t < R → ∀ (β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (s : ℝ), (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ≤ s) → ENNReal.ofReal |∫ x in Rp.carrier ∩ ball 0 t, (Rp.mult x : ℝ) * Rp.orient x (exteriorDerivative (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * Rp.measure {x : Euclid P | t - h < ‖x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ < t}) (𝓝[>] 0)
